(3) She uses a light blue, vented hairbrush to comb through the roots vigorously, causing her hair to visibly gain volume and lose its oily sheen. (4) She demonstrates the product on her forearm to show it relieves skin stickiness, holding two variations of the can—blue and pink—while smiling confidently. (5) The final sequence is a vertical screen recording showing her Instagram profile with a highlighted link and an e-commerce page listing the dry shampoo prices and product specifications.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a product endorsement for Settle Dry Shampoo, using a personal vlog style to show a relatable beauty problem (greasy hair) and its immediate solution. By demonstrating the application technique and showing 'before and after' results, the creator establishes the product's effectiveness. The narrative then expands to discuss scents and alternative uses for the body to increase value perception, finally directing viewers to a group buy link in her social media bio.
